# stackit_alb_waf_managed_rule_set (Resource)

ALB WAF Managed Rule Set resource schema. Uses the `default_region` specified in the provider configuration as a fallback in case no `region` is defined on resource level.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stackit_alb_waf_managed_rule_set" "example" {
  project_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  name       = "example-managed-rule-set"
  type       = "TYPE_OWASP_CRS"
}

# Set individual rules to a different mode, keyed by group ID and rule ID.
# Only the listed rules are managed; a rule removed from configured_groups goes back to
# MODE_ENABLED. The state of all rules is available in groups.
resource "stackit_alb_waf_managed_rule_set" "with_rule_modes" {
  project_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  name       = "example-managed-rule-set-modes"
  type       = "TYPE_OWASP_CRS"
  configured_groups = {
    "911" = {
      rules = {
        "911100" = { mode = "MODE_LOG_ONLY" } # allow PUT and DELETE through method enforcement
      }
    }
    "920" = {
      rules = {
        "920450" = { mode = "MODE_DISABLED" }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Managed Rule Set configuration name.
- `project_id` (String) STACKIT project ID associated with the ALB WAF Managed Rule Set.
- `type` (String) Type of the Managed Rule Set.

### Optional

- `configured_groups` (Attributes Map) Rule modes to set, keyed by group ID (e.g. `911`) and rule ID (e.g. `911100`). Only the listed rules are managed; every other rule keeps the mode the API gives it. A rule removed from the configuration is set back to `MODE_ENABLED`, even if its mode was changed outside Terraform in the meantime. The resulting state of all rules is available in `groups`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configured_groups))
- `region` (String) STACKIT region name the resource is located in. If not defined, the provider region is used.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes Map) Inventory of all available Managed Rule Set groups and their current configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) Terraform's internal resource identifier. Structured as "`project_id`,`region`,`name`".
- `version` (String) Managed Rule Set version.

<a id="nestedatt--configured_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configured_groups`

Required:

- `rules` (Attributes Map) Rules of the rule group, keyed by rule ID (e.g. `911100`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configured_groups--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--configured_groups--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configured_groups.rules`

Required:

- `mode` (String) The mode of the rule. Possible values are: `MODE_ENABLED`, `MODE_DISABLED`, `MODE_LOG_ONLY`.



<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) A description of what this group covers.
- `group_name` (String) The name for the rule group.
- `rules` (Attributes Map) Rules of the rule group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--groups--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups.rules`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) A description of what this rule does.
- `mode` (String) The current mode of the rule.
- `severity` (String) Impact level.
